# Mont Marte

> > Mont Marte is a global art supplies manufacturer offering premium and signature lines of acrylic paints, watercolours, brushes, and artist materials for creators at all skill levels.

Mont Marte specializes in high-quality art supplies including their flagship Dimension Acrylic Premium line (heavy body paints with texture effects), Satin Acrylic paints with ASTM2 lightfast ratings, fluid art supplies, and complete painting sets. The brand serves both professional artists and students with materials ranging from individual 75ml tubes to bulk 2L bottles.

## Key Topics

- Dimension Acrylic Premium
- Heavy body acrylic paint
- Satin acrylic paint
- ASTM2 lightfast rating
- Texture effects
- Fluid art and pouring medium
- Signature line products
- Premium art supplies
- Watercolour sets
- Poster paint (tempera)
- Artist-quality materials
- Metallic acrylic paints
- Tracing paper and sketch pads
- Acrylic brushes
- Multi-surface formulas
